nodes.title: APC PER3 performance file, 11x4.5MR
nodes.where: block 'PROP RPM = 6000', columns J, Ct, Cp (all 30 rows to zero thrust at J 0.545)
nodes.note: APC's own blade-element prediction, not a wind-tunnel test; static values run ~10 % optimistic (K09 REVIEW section 3, J1 REFERENCES). B4 owns the prop data.

nodes.title: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag (1965)
nodes.where: ch. 3: flat plate normal to flow CD 1.17-1.28 by aspect ratio; ch. 2-6 component drag
nodes.note: CD90 1.28 is the value the K09 card and REVIEW used for the hover-lean check; kept for continuity

nodes.title: Helmbold lift slope for low aspect ratio
nodes.where: Raymer, Aircraft Design: A Conceptual Approach, 6th ed., eq. 12.6 (swept form reduces to Helmbold at zero sweep)
nodes.note: a = 2 pi AR / (2 + sqrt(AR^2 + 4)) with a 2-D slope of 2 pi

nodes.title: ArduPilot Plane tailsitter and airspeed parameters
nodes.note: parameter names only; values below are B1 proposals for F4

nodes.title: 11x4.5MR Ct and Cp versus J
nodes.text: The fitted prop follows APC's PER3 Ct(J), Cp(J) at 6 000 rpm at every operating point; rows are [J, Ct, Cp]
nodes.basis: APC data file read 2026-11-09; Re effect 5 000-8 000 rpm < 1 % on Ct, Cp in the same file; the hover-table calibration (CALC-B1-PROPCAL) absorbs APC's static optimism

nodes.title: X3108S KV900 motor constants
nodes.text: [Kv rpm/V, winding resistance ohm, no-load current A] = [900, 0.080, 0.6]
nodes.basis: Kv from the part name; Rm and I0 are typical of a 31xx 900 kV motor and not read from the maker (page refused the fetch, J1). The calibration factor to the maker table absorbs most of the error at hover; E1 confirms

nodes.title: Zero-lift drag build-up coefficients
nodes.text: [Cf wing, FF wing, Cf fin/pod, FF fin, CD motor tube (frontal, faired by the fin), CdA per motor m2, FF pod, interference factor] = [0.0060, 1.25, 0.0070, 1.20, 0.30, 0.0004, 1.30, 1.15]
nodes.basis: Same coefficients as the K09 card and the K01 card, accepted by the K09 REVIEW (section 4: 'already pessimistic'); turbulent flat plate at Re 3e5 with tape seams; Hoerner for the tube

nodes.title: Zero-lift angle of the MH 45 wing
nodes.text: Zero-lift angle of attack -1.0 deg with elevons neutral
nodes.basis: MH 45 is a low-camber reflexed section; B2 replaces this with XFOIL

nodes.title: Flat-plate normal-force coefficient
nodes.text: Wing normal-force coefficient beyond stall CN = CD90 sin(alpha), CD90 = 1.28
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat plate; the value the K09 card used for hover lean, kept so the numbers compare. Low-AR wings with end plates keep more post-stall lift, so this under-predicts lift in transition (conservative)

nodes.title: ESC efficiency
nodes.text: ESC efficiency 0.95 in hover and cruise
nodes.basis: K09 card value; BLHeli_S at 7-30 A

nodes.title: Avionics and servo power
nodes.text: FC, GPS, receiver, telemetry, airspeed sensor and two elevon servos draw 6 W together
nodes.basis: card 5 W + 1 W for the two servos

nodes.title: Cruise trim drag factor
nodes.text: Elevon up-trim and differential-thrust trimming add 5 % to cruise drag
nodes.basis: K09 card TRIM_FACTOR 1.05; J1 shows the MH 45 needs elevon up-trim for SM > 2.7 %

nodes.title: Proposed cruise airspeed 16 m/s
nodes.text: B1 proposes AIRSPEED_CRUISE = 16 m/s (was 15 m/s in params.json#performance.cruise_ms)
nodes.basis: lowest whole-number speed that clears 1.3 Vs at the 2.6 kg gate with CLmax 0.9 (15.05 m/s) with ~1 m/s for airspeed-hold and sensor error; costs ~2 min of base cruise against 15 m/s (CALC-B1-SWEEP)

nodes.title: Pessimistic-case factors
nodes.text: [CD0 factor, prop efficiency factor, hover power factor] = [1.30, 0.85, 1.10]
nodes.basis: CD0 x 1.3 as the K09 REVIEW pessimistic case; prop efficiency 15 % below APC (BEMT optimism, tractor prop ahead of a fin and tube); hover +10 % for APC static optimism and 11x4.5MR vs 11x4.7 table

nodes.title: Thrust kept for attitude control
nodes.text: Steady flight may use at most 80 % of available thrust (sagged pack); 20 % stays for control
nodes.basis: common multirotor practice (hover throttle <= 50-60 %, never saturate in steady state); a tailsitter controls pitch in hover and transition by differential thrust only

nodes.title: Landing attitude error
nodes.text: Attitude error at touchdown, on top of the steady wind lean, is 10 deg
nodes.basis: first-order allowance for gusts and controller error in QLAND; C5 and H2 refine from the twin's logs

nodes.title: Pitch-over schedule
nodes.text: [pitch rate deg/s, assist speed as a fraction of Vs, back-transition energy as a fraction of the forward pitch-over] = [20, 1.10, 1.0]
nodes.basis: 20 deg/s is the fastest pitch-down rate that keeps peak thrust <= 80 % of available in CALC-B1-PITCHOVER (30 deg/s reaches 94 %, 50 deg/s saturates); proposed first-flight Q_TAILSIT_RAT_FW; thrust holds altitude below 1.1 Vs (Q_ASSIST_SPEED analogue); the back-transition is a pitch-up deceleration of similar length at similar thrust

nodes.title: Aero model: CD0, k, lift slope, stall angle
nodes.equation: Swet = 2 S (1 + 0.2 t/c) ; CD0 = IF [Cf FF Swet_wing + Cf FF Swet_fins + Cd_tube d L + n CdA_motor + Cf FF Swet_pod] / S ; k = 1/(pi AR e) ; a = 2 pi AR/(2 + sqrt(AR^2+4)) ; alpha_s = alpha0 + CLmax/a ; L/D max = 1/(2 sqrt(CD0 k))

nodes.title: Stall and transition speeds
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2 m g/(rho S CLmax)) ; Vt = 1.3 Vs ; Vs30 = Vs/sqrt(cos 30) ; margin = Vcruise/Vt - 1

nodes.title: Prop and motor chain, calibrated to the maker table
nodes.equation: n_max = sqrt(T0/(Ct0 rho D^4)) ; n_max,sag = n_max sqrt(sag) ; k_cal = P_table(690 gf) / P_motor(prop model at 690 gf, J = 0) ; FM = T^1.5/(sqrt(2 rho A) P_shaft)

nodes.title: Hover power, current, endurance and thrust headroom
nodes.equation: T_motor = m DL / n ; P = n P_table(T_motor) / eta_esc + P_av ; I = P / V ; t_hover = E (1 - reserve) / P ; throttle = m g DL / (n T_max sag)

nodes.title: Cruise at the proposed speed, gate mass
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim ; prop: Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 = D/n ; P_el = n k_cal P_motor(Cp rho n^3 D^5) / eta_esc + P_av ; pess: CD0 x 1.3, eta_prop x 0.85

nodes.title: Cruise power and cruise time versus airspeed
nodes.equation: for V in 14..20 m/s: P_el(V) as CALC-B1-CRUISE ; t = (E(1-res) - P_h t_h - 2 E_tr)/P_el

nodes.title: Mission energy: 2 min hover, two transitions, cruise
nodes.equation: E_use = E (1 - reserve) ; E_c = E_use - P_hover t_hover - E_tr (1 + back) ; t_cruise = E_c / P_cruise ; range = t_cruise V

nodes.title: Transition corridor, steady level flight
nodes.equation: for V in 0..22 m/s: T cos(th) = D(a=th), T sin(th) + L = W ; corridor th_lo..th_eq with T = (W - L)/sin(th) <= f T_max(V cos a) ; P_el at T/n ; peaks taken over 0 <= V <= Vcruise

nodes.title: Forward transition (pitch-over) time simulation
nodes.equation: m dv/dt = T(th) + L + D - W (2-D point mass, dt 0.01 s, semi-implicit Euler) ; th_cmd = max(90 - r t, th_req(V)) ; T holds altitude below V_assist, speed above

nodes.title: Hover lean, wind limits, landing and ground tip-over
nodes.equation: lean = atan(0.5 rho V^2 S CD90 / W) ; lean_allowed = tipover - err ; V_hover,max: lean = lean_allowed ; T/W at 8 m/s = 1/cos(lean) ; V_ground,tip = sqrt(2 m_min g z_fin / (h_cp rho S CD90)), h_cp = c/2 + foot

nodes.title: Vertical climb, fixed-wing climb and top speed
nodes.equation: VTOL: T = W DL + q S_front CD0 at Vc, prop at J = Vc/(nD) ; FW: ROC = (n T_max(V) f - D) V / W ; V_max: n T_max(V) = D(V)
